description.zh: 近战吸血战士，周期性的赐死剑气按目标最大生命追加伤害；大灭让他暂时升空。
description.en: A melee drain fighter whose recurring Deathbringer strike adds max-health damage. World Ender temporarily takes him into the air.

description.zh: 增加生命并暂时升空，强化吸血和被动循环；击杀刷新形态时间与加速。结束时生命截回基础上限。
description.en: Gain health and temporarily fly, with stronger life steal and passive strikes. Kills refresh the form and speed boost. Health above the base maximum is removed when it ends.

description.zh: 远程飞行法师。首次被击败化为蛋，存活后满血重生；冰雪风暴持续伤害并减速。
description.en: A ranged flying mage. Her first defeat leaves an egg that revives her at full health if it survives. Glacial Storm deals lingering damage and slows.

description.zh: 在身前创造风暴，落地伤害后周期造成伤害与减速。施法锁定移动、攻击和朝向；已落地风暴独立存在。
description.en: Create a storm ahead that deals impact damage followed by periodic damage and slows. Casting locks movement, attacks and facing; a landed storm persists independently.

description.zh: 冰鸟首次被击败后留下的地面形态。孵化成功后满血复生，不再生成新的蛋。
description.en: The ground form left after Anivia’s first defeat. Surviving the hatch restores her to full health, without another rebirth.

description.zh: 地面防守炮台，炮弹造成小范围伤害，主动激光可以穿透敌人。
description.en: A defensive turret with small-area shells against ground targets and an active piercing laser.

description.zh: 沿朝向发射穿透激光，伤害路径上的地面敌人。
description.en: Fire a piercing laser forward, damaging ground enemies along its path.

description.zh: 可对空的远程射手，以冰霜减速牵制敌人，扇形箭雨阻挡逼近的部队。
description.en: A ranged anti-air archer who controls enemies with frost slows and a fan of arrows.

description.zh: 向前方扇形发射箭矢，每箭在首个敌人处消失；同次施法对同一目标不重复伤害，并触发冰霜减速。
description.en: Fire a fan of arrows that stop at the first enemy. A target takes damage only once per cast and receives the frost slow.

description.zh: 飞行吐息单位，持续伤害锁定目标。击杀积累星辰，让星落升级为天瀑。
description.en: A flying dragon whose breath continuously damages his locked target. Kills charge Falling Star into The Skies Descend.

description.zh: 击杀充能，向前方降星造成伤害与眩晕；满层强化伤害和眩晕，并产生全场扩散冲击波。
description.en: Kills build charges. Drop a star ahead for damage and a stun; full charges empower both and add an arena-wide expanding shockwave.

description.zh: 远程召唤法师。近期被他命中的敌军死亡时转化为黄沙士兵，建筑则转化为太阳圆盘。
description.en: A ranged summoner. Recently struck enemies become Sand Soldiers on death; destroyed structures become Sun Discs.

description.zh: 在自身四周召唤黄沙士兵。
description.en: Summon Sand Soldiers around the caster.

description.zh: 只攻击建筑的大型空中单位，死亡时释放一群可攻击空地的虚空鱼。
description.en: A large flying siege unit that targets structures. On death, she releases Void Remora that attack ground and air targets.

description.zh: 向前突进，对路径上空地敌军及建筑造成一次伤害。
description.en: Dash forward and damage each enemy ground unit, air unit or structure on the path once.

description.zh: 可对空的飞行炮手，导弹碰撞后爆炸，最后一枚导弹威力更强。
description.en: A flying anti-air gunner. His missiles explode on first contact, with an empowered final missile.

description.zh: 导弹碰到首个敌人后爆炸；最后一发为强化导弹。未命中则在射程尽头消失。
description.en: The missile explodes on first enemy contact. The final missile is empowered; missed missiles vanish at maximum range.

description.zh: 持续伤害区域，同时威胁空地单位和建筑；敌人离开区域后停止受伤。
description.en: A persistent damage zone affecting ground units, air units and structures. Leaving the zone stops its damage.

description.zh: 敌方进入腐蚀区域立即受到移动减速，离开后迅速消退。
description.en: Enemies are slowed immediately on entering Corrosion; the slow fades quickly after leaving.

description.zh: 普攻叠加流血，叠满后进入血怒。断头台击杀可以获得免费追斩。
description.en: Basic attacks stack bleeding and trigger Noxian Might at full stacks. A guillotine kill grants a free follow-up execution.

description.zh: 强化下一击，按目标流血层数增伤；血怒进一步强化。技能不受致盲影响，击杀赠送免费追斩。
description.en: Empower the next strike, scaling with the target’s bleed stacks and Noxian Might. Unaffected by blind; a kill grants a free follow-up.

description.zh: 从己方水晶抛出酒桶，落地爆炸并向外击退敌军；建筑不会被击退。
description.en: A cask thrown from your Nexus explodes on arrival and knocks enemies outward. Structures cannot be displaced.

description.zh: 提高爆炸伤害，不改变范围或击退。
description.en: Increase explosion damage without changing the area or knockback.

description.zh: 冻结落点附近的敌方单位、建筑卡与防御塔，水晶免疫。
description.en: Freezes enemy units, deployed buildings and towers near the impact point. Nexuses are immune.

description.zh: 施放时另建更大的减速区域，降低移动与攻击速度；减速区域比冻结持续更久，不扩大冻结本身。
description.en: Create a larger slowing zone on cast, reducing movement and attack speed. It outlasts the freeze but does not expand the frozen area.

description.zh: 专注建筑的前排战士。用高生命承受火力，以强化攻击或旋转切入战线。
description.en: A durable frontline fighter focused on structures. Choose an empowered strike or a spinning attack to pressure the front.

description.zh: 强化下一次普攻并刷新攻击前摇，尚未打出时加速移动。
description.en: Empower the next basic attack and restart its wind-up, gaining movement speed until it is delivered.

description.zh: 旋转并周期伤害周围地面敌人。期间不能普攻，但仍可移动和转向。
description.en: Spin to periodically damage nearby ground enemies. Basic attacks are locked, but movement and turning remain possible.

description.zh: 远程小纳尔与近战大纳尔循环变形，普攻命中推动形态切换。
description.en: Cycles between ranged Mini Gnar and melee Mega Gnar. Basic-attack hits advance each transformation.

description.zh: 向前重击并眩晕地面敌人；小纳尔先变为大纳尔。
description.en: Slam forward to damage and stun ground enemies. Mini Gnar transforms first.

description.zh: 近战剪刀手，普攻和剪切附带目标最大生命伤害。可选连续剪切或阻挡圈外敌人的圣霭。
description.en: A melee skirmisher whose attacks and snips add max-health damage. Choose repeated snips or mist that blocks outside enemies.

description.zh: 普攻命中积攒剪切次数。每剪附带被动，中央提高基础伤害；满层首次实际命中回血，空放不回血。
description.en: Basic-attack hits add snips. Each snip applies the passive, with higher base damage in the center. At full charge, the first actual hit heals; a miss does not.

description.zh: 创建固定圣霭，阻止圈外敌人选取格温或施加新效果；已有状态继续生效，格温离开则结界消失。
description.en: Create fixed mist that prevents outside enemies from targeting Gwen or applying new effects. Existing effects continue; leaving the area removes the mist.

description.zh: 恢复范围内友方普通单位的生命，对建筑、防御塔与水晶无效。
description.en: Restores allied non-structure units in an area. Buildings, towers and Nexuses cannot receive this healing.

description.zh: 治疗全场友方普通单位，落点范围内治疗量进一步提高，不提供护盾。
description.en: Heal allied non-structure units across the arena, with increased healing near the chosen point. Grants no shield.

description.zh: 提高范围治疗量，部分溢出治疗转为限时护盾。
description.en: Increase area healing and convert part of excess healing into a temporary shield.

description.zh: 超级兵与炮车兵前后部署，以重装前排保护远程火力。
description.en: Deploys a Super Minion ahead of a Siege Minion, shielding ranged firepower with a heavy frontline.

description.zh: 强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。
description.en: Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

description.zh: 墓碑及召唤技能生成的小型地面近战单位。
description.en: A small ground melee unit created by Tombstone and its summoning ability.

description.zh: 近战范围战士，连续命中逐渐提高攻速，反击风暴能免疫普攻伤害。
description.en: An area melee fighter who gains attack speed through repeated hits. Counter Strike makes him immune to basic-attack damage.

description.zh: 暂时免疫普攻伤害，仍可移动攻击；结束时伤害并眩晕周围地面敌人，闪避的攻击提高伤害。死亡取消，凝滞到期不补发。
description.en: Temporarily ignore basic-attack damage while still moving and attacking. Then damage and stun nearby ground enemies, scaling with attacks avoided. Death cancels it; expiry in stasis does not defer the burst.

description.zh: 可切换火箭炮与机枪的后排射手。参与摧毁建筑后获得罪恶快感。
description.en: A backline marksman who switches between rockets and a minigun. Taking part in a structure takedown triggers Get Excited.

description.zh: 切换武器并重置旧普攻后摇，切换期间不能攻击；机枪命中叠攻速，换武器清空层数。
description.en: Switch weapons and reset the old attack recovery. Attacks are locked during the switch. Minigun hits stack attack speed; switching clears those stacks.

description.zh: 浮空但仍属于地面单位，可以直接过河并穿过普通单位，仍受建筑阻挡。
description.en: A hovering ground fighter who crosses the river and passes through ordinary units, but remains blocked by structures.

description.zh: 向前传送并伤害落点附近敌人。连续使用提高费用和伤害，达到上限后不再增加；建筑阻挡会调整落点。
description.en: Blink forward and damage nearby enemies on arrival. Repeated casts increase cost and damage up to a cap. Structures force the landing point to adjust.

description.zh: 根据部署时的金币自动选择近战或远程形态。两种形态都能飞行、攻击空地目标。
description.en: Available gold selects her melee or ranged form on deployment. Both forms fly and attack ground and air targets.

description.zh: 回复自身生命并短暂加速。
description.en: Restore health and briefly increase movement speed.

description.zh: 远程飞行形态，普攻同时发射追踪光剑和独立的穿透焰浪。
description.en: A ranged flying form whose attacks launch both a homing light blade and an independent piercing flame wave.

description.zh: 回复自身生命并短暂加速。
description.en: Restore health and briefly increase movement speed.

description.zh: 穿越地形的成长战士。对远程或近战敌军的普攻任务决定后续部署的进阶形态。
description.en: A terrain-crossing fighter. Basic-attack quests against ranged or melee enemies unlock a form for future deployments.

description.zh: 向前突进后旋转，分段伤害地面敌人。拉亚斯特附加最大生命伤害，并在每段命中时回复生命。
description.en: Dash forward, then spin, damaging ground enemies in separate stages. Rhaast adds max-health damage and heals on a hit in each stage.

description.zh: 凯隐的高速进阶形态，进入地形回复生命并短暂加速。
description.en: Kayn’s fast advanced form, healing and briefly accelerating when entering terrain.

description.zh: 向前突进后旋转，分段伤害地面敌人。拉亚斯特附加最大生命伤害，并在每段命中时回复生命。
description.en: Dash forward, then spin, damaging ground enemies in separate stages. Rhaast adds max-health damage and heals on a hit in each stage.

description.zh: 凯隐的续航进阶形态，普攻与技能附带最大生命伤害，并通过命中回血。
description.en: Kayn’s sustain form. Attacks and ability hits add max-health damage and restore health.

description.zh: 向前突进后旋转，分段伤害地面敌人。拉亚斯特附加最大生命伤害，并在每段命中时回复生命。
description.en: Dash forward, then spin, damaging ground enemies in separate stages. Rhaast adds max-health damage and heals on a hit in each stage.

description.zh: 连续选择区域内尚未受击、当前生命最高的目标，造成伤害和短暂眩晕。
description.en: Repeatedly strikes the highest-current-health enemy in the area that this cast has not yet hit, dealing damage and a brief stun.

description.zh: 逐段提高电击伤害；某段无目标不会改变后续段的伤害档位。
description.en: Increase damage with each strike. A strike with no target does not change later damage tiers.

description.zh: 周期召唤皮克斯的远程法师，可永久强化一名尚未被增益的友军。
description.en: A ranged mage who periodically summons Pix and can permanently empower an ally that has not already received Wild Growth.

description.zh: 选择范围内费用最高、同费最近的未增益友军，永久增加生命和体型并击退周围敌军。不能重复增益；无目标则退还消耗。
description.en: Permanently increase health and size for the highest-cost eligible ally in range, preferring the nearest on ties, and knock back nearby enemies. Cannot stack; no valid target refunds the cast.

description.zh: 慢速前排坦克，部署时获得花岗岩护盾。护盾存在时减伤，破碎后不再生。
description.en: A slow frontline tank deployed with Granite Shield. It reduces incoming damage while intact and does not regenerate once broken.

description.zh: 伤害周围地面敌人，同时降低移动和攻击速度。
description.en: Damage nearby ground enemies and reduce their movement and attack speed.

description.zh: 空中后排召唤法师，周期召唤虚灵。可选压制引导或额外召唤。
description.en: A flying backline mage who periodically summons Voidlings. Choose a disabling channel or an additional swarm.

description.zh: 下一击命中后引导眩晕，自身不能移动或攻击。控制可打断引导，但已建立的持续伤害区域独立存在。
description.en: The next hit begins a stunning channel that locks the caster’s movement and attacks. Control can interrupt the channel, but the established damage zone persists independently.

description.zh: 施法期间停止普攻，开启裂隙依次召唤虚灵。
description.en: Pause basic attacks while casting, opening a rift that summons Voidlings in sequence.

description.zh: 移动与攻击都很快的地面近战单位，适合迅速接近脆弱后排。
description.en: A fast-moving ground melee fighter with rapid attacks, suited to closing on fragile backline units.

description.zh: 提高移动与攻击速度，并免疫移速和攻速减速。
description.en: Increase movement and attack speed while ignoring slows to either.

description.zh: 低费用地面近战兵，可为后排承受伤害，也会出现在自然兵线中。
description.en: A low-cost ground melee minion that protects the backline and also appears in lane waves.

description.zh: 强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。
description.en: Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

description.zh: 方阵部署近战兵，主动技能强化本次部署中仍存活的成员。
description.en: Deploys melee minions in a square. Its active empowers the surviving members of this deployment.

description.zh: 强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。
description.en: Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

description.zh: 近战与远程兵组成混合编队，分别承担前排与持续输出。
description.en: A mixed formation of melee and ranged minions, combining frontline protection with sustained fire.

description.zh: 强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。
description.en: Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

description.zh: 复制上一张成功使用的非镜像卡，按实际部署形态支付基础费用。主动席的镜像可继承预选技能。
description.en: Copies the last successfully played non-Mirror card at the base cost of its deployed form. In an active seat, Mirror can inherit the preselected ability.

description.zh: 可对空的双枪射手，对每个目标的首次攻击造成更高伤害。
description.en: An anti-air marksman whose first attack against each target deals increased damage.

description.zh: 短暂提高移动速度与攻击速度。
description.en: Temporarily increase movement and attack speed.

description.zh: 可攻击空地目标的飞行近战单位，可选抵挡敌方效果或强化下一次攻击。
description.en: A flying melee unit that attacks ground and air targets. Choose to block an enemy effect or empower the next attack.

description.zh: 抵挡一次完整敌方攻击、法术或技能及其附带效果，成功后加攻速。已有状态和友方效果不受影响。
description.en: Block one complete enemy attack, spell or ability and its attached effects, then gain attack speed. Existing statuses and allied effects remain unaffected.

description.zh: 强化下一次普攻，追加周围范围伤害并按实际生命伤害回血；不能叠加储存。
description.en: Empower the next basic attack with nearby area damage and healing based on actual health damage. Cannot store multiple charges.

description.zh: 并排部署的双斧战士，主动技能同时强化本批仍存活的狂战士。
description.en: A pair of axe-wielding melee fighters. Their active empowers every surviving Olaf from this deployment.

description.zh: 本批存活狂战士获得限时护盾、攻速和普攻吸血。护盾耗尽不会提前结束其他增益。
description.en: Grant surviving Olafs in the group a temporary shield, attack speed and basic-attack life steal. Losing the shield does not end the other buffs.

description.zh: 编队成员的单只参考条目，不能独立加入卡组。
description.en: A reference entry for an individual formation member, unavailable as a separate deck card.

description.zh: 本批存活狂战士获得限时护盾、攻速和普攻吸血。护盾耗尽不会提前结束其他增益。
description.en: Grant surviving Olafs in the group a temporary shield, attack speed and basic-attack life steal. Losing the shield does not end the other buffs.

description.zh: 只攻击建筑的慢速坦克，锻造飞锤永久强化友军普攻，冲锋撞障碍可触发眩晕。
description.en: A slow siege tank whose forged hammer permanently buffs allied basic attacks. Charging into an obstacle triggers a stun.

description.zh: 蓄力后向前冲锋，路径伤害较低；撞上建筑、河流或边界才触发范围伤害与眩晕。
description.en: Charge forward after a wind-up, dealing minor path damage. Only collision with a structure, river or arena edge triggers area damage and a stun.

description.zh: 可在河道外的全图合法地面部署，落地滑行造成伤害，普攻积攒红怒强化长枪。
description.en: Deploys on legal ground outside the river across the arena. His landing sweep deals damage; attacks build Mortal Will for his spear.

description.zh: 向前刺击地面敌人，满红怒时消耗全部层数提高伤害；未满时保留并增加红怒。
description.en: Thrust into ground enemies ahead. Full Mortal Will is consumed for higher damage; otherwise retain and add a stack.

description.zh: 成组部署的小型空中射手，近距离发射紫色光弹。
description.en: A group of tiny flying shooters that fire purple bolts at close range.

description.zh: 本批存活皮克斯的后续普攻按实际生命伤害回血，可暂时超过基础生命上限；护盾伤害与过量伤害不计入。
description.en: Surviving Pix in this group heal from actual health damage dealt by subsequent basic attacks, up to an increased health cap. Shield damage and overkill do not count.

description.zh: 用于查看单只皮克斯的关联实体，不可独立选入卡组。
description.en: An individual Pix reference entity, unavailable as a separate deck card.

description.zh: 本批存活皮克斯的后续普攻按实际生命伤害回血，可暂时超过基础生命上限；护盾伤害与过量伤害不计入。
description.en: Surviving Pix in this group heal from actual health damage dealt by subsequent basic attacks, up to an increased health cap. Shield damage and overkill do not count.

description.zh: 低费用后排兵种，可以攻击地面和空中目标。
description.en: A low-cost backline minion that attacks both ground and air targets.

description.zh: 强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。
description.en: Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

description.zh: 紧凑三角形部署远程兵，主动技能强化本批存活成员。
description.en: Deploys caster minions in a compact triangle. The active empowers surviving members of this group.

description.zh: 强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。
description.en: Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

description.zh: 只攻击建筑的重型推进单位。一生一次冲撞，撞击后释放虚空蠕虫并失去部分当前生命。
description.en: A heavy siege unit with a once-per-life charge. Impact releases Voidmites and costs a portion of its current health.

description.zh: 伤害前方半圆的地面敌军及建筑，冲撞的准备、冲刺与收势期间不可用。
description.en: Damage ground enemies and structures in a forward semicircle. Unavailable during charge preparation, movement and recovery.

description.zh: 黄沙长矛士兵，仅攻击地面，不继承沙漠皇帝的转化能力。
description.en: A spear-wielding ground soldier that does not inherit Azir’s conversion passive.

description.zh: 为本次部署成员提供护盾，到期时逐人判断，盾未破则回满生命。召唤士兵不自动获得主动资格。
description.en: Shield deployment members; on expiry, each member with an intact shield heals to full. Summoned soldiers do not automatically gain active eligibility.

description.zh: 不造成普攻伤害的支援坦克，在建筑前跳舞回血，死亡后留下友方治疗区。
description.en: A support tank without basic-attack damage. It dances and heals near structures, leaving an allied healing zone on death.

description.zh: 降低周围敌人的移动与攻击速度。
description.en: Reduce nearby enemies’ movement and attack speed.

description.zh: 交替双拳攻击的近战前排，第二拳伤害更高，蓄意轰拳将豪意转为爆发和护盾。
description.en: A frontline brawler with a stronger second punch. Haymaker turns Grit into burst damage and a shield.

description.zh: 锁定行动后向前轰出梯形冲击波，豪意提高伤害，中心伤害更高；消耗的豪意同时提供衰减护盾。
description.en: Lock actions to release a trapezoid blast. Grit increases damage, with extra damage in the center, and provides a decaying shield.

description.zh: 横排部署黄沙士兵。只有摧毁敌方两路防御塔后，才能部署到对方半场合法区域。
description.en: Deploys a line of Sand Soldiers. Enemy-side deployment requires both opposing lane towers to be destroyed.

description.zh: 为本次部署成员提供护盾，到期时逐人判断，盾未破则回满生命。召唤士兵不自动获得主动资格。
description.en: Shield deployment members; on expiry, each member with an intact shield heals to full. Summoned soldiers do not automatically gain active eligibility.

description.zh: 远程炮击兵种，攻击较慢，但能从后方持续施压。
description.en: A long-range artillery minion with slow attacks and sustained backline pressure.

description.zh: 强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。
description.en: Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

description.zh: 三角形部署炮车兵，以多门远程火炮压制战线。
description.en: Deploys a triangle of Siege Minions to pressure the battlefield with multiple artillery units.

description.zh: 强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。
description.en: Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

description.zh: 高生命攻城坦克，首次致死后短暂不可选中，再满血复生为持续流失生命的狂暴形态。
description.en: A high-health siege tank. His first lethal hit starts an untargetable revival, then a full-health berserk form that steadily loses health.

description.zh: 获得护盾，计时结束时若护盾未破，移除剩余护盾并对周围空地单位及建筑造成伤害。
description.en: Gain a shield. If it survives until expiry, remove it and damage nearby ground units, air units and structures.

description.zh: 星光抵达后同时凝滞双方单位。凝滞时无法行动、被选取或受伤，但保留碰撞；水晶免疫。
description.en: Starlight places both sides in stasis on arrival. Affected units cannot act, be targeted or take damage, but retain collision. Nexuses are immune.

description.zh: 缩短友军凝滞时间，敌方时长不变。
description.en: Shorten allied stasis without changing enemy duration.

description.zh: 可对空的防守建筑，也能建立在已毁防御塔的精确塔墟上，免除持续生命衰减。
description.en: An anti-air defensive building. Placing it precisely on a destroyed tower foundation removes its ongoing health decay.

description.zh: 为攻击范围内所有存活友方单位和建筑提供限时护盾，包括防御塔和水晶。
description.en: Grant a temporary shield to living allies within attack range, including buildings, towers and the Nexus.

description.zh: 高生命、高伤害的重型近战兵，为一路推进提供坚实前排。
description.en: A heavy melee minion with high health and damage, providing a strong frontline for a lane push.

description.zh: 强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。
description.en: Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

description.zh: 并排部署超级兵，以重型近战阵线推进。
description.en: Deploys Super Minions side by side to form a heavy melee frontline.

description.zh: 强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。
description.en: Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

description.zh: 可选的防守建筑，用生命吸引火力，不能普攻；与练习用木桩不同。
description.en: A selectable defensive building that absorbs fire but cannot attack. Distinct from the practice dummy.

description.zh: 暂时减伤，到期后向周围爆炸；死亡取消，凝滞中到期不爆炸。
description.en: Temporarily reduce damage, then explode nearby. Death cancels the explosion; expiry during stasis prevents it.

description.zh: 灵活的远程射手，可用技能吹箭使敌人的后续普攻失效。
description.en: A mobile ranged shooter whose ability dart makes subsequent enemy basic attacks deal no damage.

description.zh: 下一次出手改为技能吹箭，使目标后续普攻无法造成伤害。该吹箭自身不受致盲影响，也不消耗致盲次数。
description.en: Replace the next strike with an ability dart that prevents damage from subsequent basic attacks. The dart ignores blind and does not consume blind charges.

description.zh: 有寿命的召唤建筑，周期生成雾行者，死亡时额外召唤。
description.en: A temporary summoning building that periodically creates Mist Walkers and releases more on death.

description.zh: 立即召唤额外的雾行者。
description.en: Summon additional Mist Walkers.

description.zh: 可对空的远程炮手，急速射击让她短时间内倾泻火力。
description.en: An anti-air ranged gunner whose Rapid Fire delivers a short burst of faster attacks.

description.zh: 暂时提高攻击速度，缩短攻击间隔。
description.en: Temporarily increase attack speed and shorten the attack interval.

description.zh: 普攻积攒怒气，满怒攻击暴击。无尽怒火可在短时间内拒绝死亡。
description.en: Basic attacks build Fury for a critical strike at full Fury. Undying Rage briefly prevents death.

description.zh: 立即满怒并暂时拒绝死亡，暴击不消耗怒气。除凝滞外可在控制中使用，不解除控制，也不治疗。
description.en: Fill Fury and temporarily prevent death; critical hits do not consume Fury. Usable under control except stasis, but does not cleanse control or heal.

description.zh: 可对空的远程法师，能在河道外的全图合法地面部署。
description.en: An anti-air ranged mage who can deploy on legal ground outside the river across the arena.

description.zh: 向前方发射穿透牌，命中空地敌军；同次施法对同一敌人只造成一次伤害。
description.en: Fire piercing cards ahead at ground and air enemies. Each enemy takes damage only once per cast.

description.zh: 脱战后隐身的射手。攻击起手破隐，隐身不免疫范围伤害。
description.en: A marksman who becomes invisible after leaving combat. Starting an attack reveals him; invisibility does not prevent area damage.

description.zh: 提高攻速、弹速与射程，普攻改为固定方向的穿透弩箭，不再追踪移动目标。
description.en: Increase attack speed, projectile speed and range. Attacks become straight piercing bolts that no longer track moving targets.

description.zh: 有寿命的召唤建筑，持续生成虚空兽，也可主动摧毁以追加召唤。
description.en: A temporary building that repeatedly creates Voidspawn. It can be sacrificed to summon additional units.

description.zh: 立即摧毁传送门并召唤虚空兽。
description.en: Immediately destroy the portal and summon Voidspawn.

description.zh: 高生命支援坦克，建筑前自疗，死亡留下治疗区；被击杀给对方金币，主动自尽免除赏金。
description.en: A high-health support tank that heals near structures and leaves a healing zone on death. Being killed awards enemy gold; self-sacrifice avoids that bounty.

description.zh: 立即死亡并留下治疗区，不给敌方金币赏金。
description.en: Die immediately and leave the healing zone, without granting enemy bounty gold.

description.zh: 成对部署的攻城生物，接近目标后牺牲自身，跃向固定落点并爆炸伤害锁定建筑。
description.en: A pair of siege creatures that sacrifice themselves near a target, leap to a fixed point and explode against the locked structure.

description.zh: 永久提高本批成员的伤害、生命、体型和移动速度。
description.en: Permanently increase this group’s damage, health, size and movement speed.

description.zh: 虚空兽的单只召唤实体，保留牺牲攻城能力，不可独立加入卡组。
description.en: An individual summoned Voidspawn with the same sacrifice attack, unavailable as a separate deck card.

description.zh: 永久提高本批成员的伤害、生命、体型和移动速度。
description.en: Permanently increase this group’s damage, health, size and movement speed.

description.zh: 在固定区域内持续召唤近战虚空鱼。强化后，区域内符合条件的真正死亡可转化为更多己方虚空鱼。
description.en: Repeatedly summons melee Void Remora in a fixed area. When enhanced, eligible actual deaths inside the zone create additional allied remora.

description.zh: 区域持续期间，双方符合条件的非建筑单位真正死亡时生成己方近战虚空鱼；近战虚空鱼不参与转化。
description.en: During the zone’s lifetime, eligible non-structure units from either team create allied melee remora on actual death. Melee remora are excluded.

description.zh: 虚空女皇与虚空召唤生成的小型飞行近战单位，可攻击空地目标。
description.en: A small flying melee unit created by Bel’Veth and Void Summoning, able to attack ground and air targets.

description.zh: 三角编队的远程空军，可用虚空再生为本批成员提供限时死亡替换。
description.en: A triangle of ranged flying units. Void Regeneration gives the group a temporary replacement-on-death effect.

description.zh: 限时标记本批存活成员，期间被击杀则原地生成新鱼；新鱼不继承再生或主动资格。
description.en: Temporarily mark surviving members. A marked unit killed during the effect is replaced at its death position. Replacements inherit neither regeneration nor active eligibility.

description.zh: 更大的远程空军编队，六边形部署，共享本批成员的虚空再生。
description.en: A larger hexagonal ranged air formation, sharing Void Regeneration across its deployed members.

description.zh: 限时标记本批存活成员，期间被击杀则原地生成新鱼；新鱼不继承再生或主动资格。
description.en: Temporarily mark surviving members. A marked unit killed during the effect is replaced at its death position. Replacements inherit neither regeneration nor active eligibility.

description.zh: 虚空再生生成的单只远程鱼，不继承再生或主动技能资格。
description.en: An individual ranged remora created by regeneration, without inherited regeneration or active-ability eligibility.

description.zh: 限时标记本批存活成员，期间被击杀则原地生成新鱼；新鱼不继承再生或主动资格。
description.en: Temporarily mark surviving members. A marked unit killed during the effect is replaced at its death position. Replacements inherit neither regeneration nor active eligibility.

description.zh: 虚空先知召唤的小型地面近战单位。
description.en: A small ground melee unit summoned by Malzahar.

description.zh: 峡谷先锋撞击建筑后生成的小型攻城召唤物，仅攻击建筑。
description.en: A small summoned siege unit released by Rift Herald on structure impact. It targets structures only.

description.zh: 近战战士，部署时以新月护卫伤害并击退周围敌人，连续攻击恢复生命。
description.en: A melee fighter whose deployment sweep damages and knocks back nearby enemies. Repeated attacks restore health.

description.zh: 挥舞长枪伤害并击退周围敌人，施放期间锁定移动、攻击和朝向。
description.en: Sweep the spear to damage and knock back nearby enemies, locking movement, attacks and facing while casting.

description.zh: 重铲命中造成小范围伤害，临终仪式强化下一击，并在命中时回复生命。
description.en: His shovel strikes deal small-area damage. Last Rites empowers the next hit and heals him on impact.

description.zh: 强化下一次范围攻击，命中时固定回复生命，每次攻击只治疗一次。
description.en: Empower the next area attack and restore a fixed amount of health on hit, only once per attack.

description.zh: 小范围电击，可同时命中地面、空中和建筑目标，并附带短暂眩晕。
description.en: A small-area lightning strike that hits ground units, air units and structures, with a brief stun.

description.zh: 在相同位置追加一次电击，重复伤害与眩晕。
description.en: Add another strike at the same position, repeating its damage and stun.

max_health_ratio.zh: 可达到的生命上限倍率

on_hit_tower_damage.en: Flat tower and Nexus bonus damage

damage_per_dodge.zh: 每次闪避额外伤害比例

cost_by_use.zh: 逐次施放费用（末档封顶）
cost_by_use.en: Cost per cast (capped at last tier)
